title: bounded-lattice
description: A lattice carrying a greatest element ⊤ and a least element ⊥ — the object generated by closing the lattice operations under the nullary case. The floor settling's ascent begins from and the ceiling it cannot pass.

top.description: ⊤ with a ≤ ⊤ for all a — the join of the carrier / meet of the empty set

bottom.description: ⊥ with ⊥ ≤ a for all a — the meet of the carrier / join of the empty set
